notes.title: Patch 1.17 - Check Out The Latest Update Now!
notes.notes:
A few weeks ago, the mobile version of our online collectible card game was saved from oblivion. It's back stronger than ever with a balancing update that should be a crowd pleaser!

Born from cooperation among the gods and above all thanks to help from the community, Krosmaga has received new balancing and several bug fixes. 
The Krosmaga team would like to thank its community on [url=https://discord.gg/JJ8jjGGm]Discord[/url], and in particular [b]Lodesu, Chevalentin, Crystauw, Salamandar, WaRtTog, Ex-BraveOdin, Flaxeau, Pepe-Senjutsu, Quentin, Show, snipouze,[/b] and [b]stinky[/b] for their valuable help.

notes.title: Krosmaga: Game Over for the Mobile Version
notes.notes:
The [b]online trading card game[/b] that needs no introduction (it's Krosmaga, for those who may have spent a bit too long rushing dungeons!) [b]will soon lose its mobile version.[/b] Don't worry – the gods will keep on vying for power on [b]PC[/b] and [b]Mac![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430684/e5f725f176495612032c17018b3cbad68514bb6c.jpg[/img]

From [b]07/04/2024[/b] on, the [b]trading card game of the krosmic deities[/b] will [b]no longer be available as a mobile version,[/b] either on [b]iOS[/b] or [b]Android[/b] – so you won't be able to download the game there anymore. Also, the [b]upcoming update[/b] will make it impossible to log in to Krosmaga through these platforms.

Even so, the adventure continues with a [b]version on PC[/b] and [b]Mac,[/b] which will still offer great opportunities to play with the [b]gods' prodigious powers![/b]

We also wanted to let you know that [b]launching Krosmaga[/b] on [b]Steam[/b] will work like a charm now! We're very sorry for the inconvenience.
 

[h3][b]There's still a bright future ahead for godly squabbles fueled by ego…[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.11: IT’S A TRAP!
notes.notes:
Update 1.11 balances a few cards, fixes a few bugs, and provides a new main menu!


[h1]WHAT'S NEW[/h1]
 
[b]GENERAL[/b]

[list][*]Following the Trophy and Platform creation contest, we've added two new offering quests that let you win the Flying Forban platform/medalion and the Champion of Flead trophy.
[*]The main menu has been given a facelift to more clearly display the various menus.
[*]We've improved the start of the game for new players after they complete the tutorial.
[*]More to win per victory: Each victory now earns you 10 kamas, up to 120 kamas per day.
[*]More roulette winnings: The 5-kama and 5–krosmic dust thresholds have been replaced by a 15-kama/15-fragment threshold. You'll now get boosters more often.[/list]
 

[h1]BALANCING[/h1]
 
[b]GENERAL[/b]

[list][*]Bodyguard: In order to make this ability more consistent and comprehensive, the mechanic has been changed. In the event of area-of-effect damage, bodyguards now receive damage first.[/list]
 
[u]Eniripsa[/u]

[list][*]Asprogik Fousand: Health points changed from 4 HP to 2 HP.[/list]
 
[u]Sram[/u]

[list][*]Sufod: Effect modified. "Banishes the last card that went to your discard pile to be summoned," is now "APPEARANCE: Puts the first Sram from your deck in your hand if your discard pile is not empty." Cost increased from 0 AP to 2 AP.
[*]Funereal Initiate: Effect modified. "NECRO. APPEARANCE: Puts the first trap from your deck in your hand," becomes "NECRO. APPEARANCE: Puts the first trap from your deck in your hand; it costs 1 AP less." Cost changed from 5 AP to 4 AP.
[*]Treacherous Heroine: Effect modified. "Reduces the countdown of Sram traps in your opponent's hand by 1 turn," becomes "As long as she's in play, activated traps from your opponent's hand cost 4 AP more and inflict 1 extra damage." Health points changed from 3 HP to 4 HP.
[*]Unsettling Trap: Cost reduced from 4 AP to 2 AP.
[*]Activated Unsettling Trap: Effect modified. "Draw 2 cards. You have 3 turns to play it, or all your Dofus will suffer 2 damage," becomes "Draw 2 cards. You have 1 turn to play it, or all your Dofus will suffer 1 damage."
[*]Lethal Trap: Cost changed from 4 AP to 3 AP.
[*]Activated Lethal Trap: Effect changed. "Destroy one of your Minions. You have 3 turns to play it, or all your Dofus will suffer 2 damage," becomes "Destroy one of your Minions. You have 1 turn to play it, or all your Dofus will suffer 1 damage."
[*]Activated Explosive Trap: Effect modified. "Inflicts 2 damage on your Minions. You have 3 turns to play it, or all your Dofus will suffer 2 damage," becomes "Inflicts 3 damage on your Minions. You have 1 turn to play it, or all your Dofus will suffer 1 damage."[/list]
 
[u]Neutral[/u]

[list][*]Shadow: Effect modified. "END OF TURN: Puts 1 card from your hand in your opponent's hand and puts 1 card from your opponent's hand in your hand," becomes "APPEARANCE: Repel a Minion by 7 cells. Inflict 4 damage on it if you have a vigilante on the field." Attack changed from 6 AT to 4 AT. Health points changed from 3 HP to 6 HP.
[*]Prince Lackbeard: Effect modified. "COUNTERATTACK: Puts the last Minion that went to your discard pile in your deck," becomes "COUNTERATTACK: Puts the last Minion that went to your discard pile in your hand." Health points changed from 4 HP to 5 HP.[/list]
 

[h1]BUGFIXES[/h1]
 
[b]GENERAL[/b]

[list][*]Fixed a bug in the loading screen that made the gods pass in front of the rest of the interface.
[*]Fixed a bug that made the sides of the field appear when the quality was changed during the tutorial.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed event cards to appear before their unlock date. [/list]
 
[b]CARDS[/b]

[list][*]Fixed a bug that resulted in card cost reductions not always being un-applied after they were activated (for example, Amalia** when Maddolls were on the field, or Emma Sacker returned to a hand and played again immediately).
[*]Fixed a typo in the HORDE effect help window.
[*]Botany: The text now indicates that only one allied seed can be transformed.[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.6: Al Howin is here!
notes.notes:
Discover the rebalancing of the Iop and Xelor gods, and the new Al Howin cards in this patch!



[h1]CHANGES[/h1]

[b][u]IN COMBAT[/u][/b]
 
[list][*]The end-of-fight screen now displays the fight participants' names.[/list]
 

[b]New Cards[/b]
 
The following cards are available in the Vampyro Pack (see Miscellaneous), or can be crafted as usual.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430684/740865784406f175dcd0141b19657f491fccc251.png[/img]
 

[b]New Skills[/b]
 
[list][*]Pile of Bones: When this Minion dies, it leaves a Pile of Bones behind on its cell.
[*]Horde: Whenever one of your Ghouls dies, the cost of your other Ghouls is reduced by 1 AP.[/list]
 

[b][u]INTERFACES[/u][/b]
 
[list][*]The Krosmaga loading screen is now decorated with the Al Howin's Day colors.
[*]Special packs can now be bought directly from the in-game Shop.[/list]
 

[b][u]MISCELLANEOUS[/u][/b]
 
[list][*]Event Quests: this new system will offer all players regular time-limited quests for special occasions. 
[*]Vampyro Pack: this pack is now available from the Shop. It contains 12 new cards (3 copies of each card, except Krosmic and Infinite cards), 1 platform, 4 special emotes and 4 phrases to be used in game.[/list]
 

[h1]BUGFIXES[/h1]
 
[b][u]IN COMBAT[/u][/b]
 
[list][*]In the tutorial, if the player plays 2 cards in quick succession, the second card's animation is no longer blocked until they tap "End Your Turn".
[*]Fixed a bug where veterans under 1000 Elo get a winstreak bonus.
Final blows are now also dealt if the destroyed Minion was the Bodyguard of the attacked Minion.
[*]The Vampire family is now the Ghoul family.
[*]Damage spell reductions (Joris **, for example) are applied to all damages not dealt by a Minion (spell/Sinistro/Necronomigore/Seed/Bomb/ etc.).
[*]Fixed a lock-up when the AI was trying to target an Untargetable Minion with a Minion's effect.
[*]Seed, Bomb, Loot, etc. type items on the battlefield now have a display to show which team they belong to.
[*]The XP gain animation for Infinites in combat no longer hinders play, finishing more quickly.
[*]Spectator mode in hidden mode no longer displays the Dofus or the cards of the person being watched.[/list]
 

[b][u]CARDS[/u][/b]
 
[list][*]Midgin Knight: Text updated to correctly describe its actual effect. Becomes: "APPEARANCE: Charges 1 cell if an enemy Minion is in front of it."
[*]Midgin Bruiser: Text updated to correctly describe its actual effect. Becomes: "Gains shield if an enemy Minion is in front of it."
[*]Ayt Diod (Sinistro): A Sinistro destroyed by a Timekeeper no longer inflicts damage opposite itself when it is no longer visible in game.
[*]Ayt Diod (Sinistro): The Sinistro's damage is now reduced by Joris **.
[*]Blood Tie: When the protector is killed, the protected tag is removed from the Dofus.
[*]Blood Tie: Can no longer be cast on a Minion who is already protecting a Dofus.
[*]Cowardly Maskemane: Now, its effect is launched when any enemy Minion appears opposite it, even a "secondary" Minion.
[*]Offended Oracle: No longer awards a double bonus to Paladirs as if they were Sacriers.
[*]Drhellerstein: If used when the opponent's hand is full, the card which leaves and immediately returns to the discard pile will still be correctly displayed.
[*]Sacrifice: Fixed a bug where the damage inflicted by Sacrifice was only taking into account the creature's basic attack and not any bonuses it might have.
[*]Comen Goe: Fixed a bug that could display the coin toss opposite its position on the battlefield when Comen Goe was destroyed.[/list]
 

[b][u]BALANCING[/u][/b]
 
[b]Common/uncommon/rare neutrals[/b]
 
[list][*]Chafer Bow Meow: Skill changed: "Gains +1 AT and +1 AR whenever an allied Bow Meow enters into play." becomes: "PILE OF BONES. Gains +1 AT and +1 AR whenever an allied Bow Meow enters into play."
[*]Chafer Archer: Skill changed: "RANGE: 1-3. DEATH: Summons a Decrepit Chafer if another allied Chafer is in play." becomes: "PILE OF BONES. RANGE: 1-2. APPEARANCE: Puts a Pile of Bones on your side." Cost reduced from 3 AP to 2 AP. Movement points increased from 2 to 3.
[*]Decrepit Chafer: Skill changed: "Can never be resuscitated" becomes: "IRREMOVABLE". Attack increased from 1 to 3. HP reduced from 2 to 1.
Elite Chafer: Skill changed: "DEATH: Summons a Decrepit Chafer if another allied Chafer is in play." becomes: "PILE OF BONES. APPEARANCE: Destroy a Pile of Bones to gain +1 AT, +1 AR and +1 MP.". Attack increased from 3 to 4.
[*]Chafer Lancer: Skill changed: "DEATH: Summons a Decrepit Chafer if another allied Chafer is in play." becomes: "PILE OF BONES. APPEARANCE: Adds a Pile of Bones to your hand." Cost reduced from 3 AP to 2 AP. HP reduced from 3 to 2. Movement Points increased from 2 to 3.
[*]Translucent Chafer: Skill changed: "UNTARGETABLE. DEATH: Summons a Decrepit Chafer if another allied Chafer is in play." becomes: "PILE OF BONES. UNTARGETABLE."
[*]Chaferfu: Skill changed: "Teleports 2 cells when an ally dies. DEATH: Summons a Decrepit Chafer if another allied Chafer is in play." becomes: "PILE OF BONES. "Teleports 2 cells when an allied Chafer dies.". HP increased from 3 to 4. Movement Points increased from 1 to 2.
[*]Bat: Skill changed: "APPEARANCE: Discard 1 random card from your hand." becomes: "HORDE.". Cost increased from 1 AP to 2 AP. Its family changes from Vampire to Ghoul. Attack reduced from 3 to 2.
[*]Beefy Bat: Skill changed: "Heals your other Minions by 1 HP whenever it injures an enemy." becomes "HORDE. APPEARANCE: Gains +1 AT per allied Ghoul in play.". Cost increased from 4 AP to 6 AP. Attack increased from 1 to 2. HP increased from 5 to 6. Movement Points increased from 2 to 3. Its family changes from Vampire to Ghoul.
[*]Crobak: Skill added: "APPEARANCE: Charges 1 cell.". Movement Points reduced from 4 to 3.
[*]Ghoul: Skill changed: "COUNTERATTACK: Teleports 3 cells forwards." becomes: "HORDE. APPEARANCE: Put the first Ghoul from your deck in your hand. Cost increased from 2 AP to 4 AP. Attack increased from 1 to 2. HP reduced from 4 to 2. Movement Points increased from 1 to 3. Its family changes from Vampire to Ghoul.
[*]Ghourmand: Skill changed: "Teleports 2 cells forward whenever an allied Minion suffers damage." becomes: "HORDE. APPEARANCE: Gains +3 AT if you have no Ghouls on the board.". Cost reduced from 5 AP to 4 AP. Attack reduced from 4 to 2. Movement Points increased from 1 to 3. Its family changes from Vampire to Ghoul.
[*]Miliboowolf: Attack increased from 1 to 2.
[*]Miliboowerewolf: Cost reduced from 4 AP to 3 AP.
[*]Boowolf: Skill changed: "FINAL BLOW: Transforms into a Boowerewolf." becomes: "FINAL BLOW: Transforms into an Alpha Boowolf". Cost reduced from 6 AP to 5 AP. HP reduced from 5 to 4.
[*]Alpha Boowolf: Skill changed: "As long as it is in play, your Boowolves cost 2 AP less." becomes: "FINAL BLOW: Transforms into a Boowerewolf.". Attack increased from 4 to 5. HP increased from 4 to 5. Cost increased from 5 to 6.
[*]Boowerewolf: Skill changed: "FINAL BLOW: Gains +2 AT." becomes: "FINAL BLOW: Is healed by 2 HP."
[*]Boowolfine: Skill changed: "FINAL BLOW: Heals your other Boowolves by 2 HP." becomes: "APPEARANCE: Puts the first Boowolf from your deck in your hand.". Cost reduced from 6 AP to 5 AP. HP reduced from 5 to 4.
[*]Grinch: Attack increased from 1 to 2. HP increased from 1 to 2. Movement Points reduced from 3 to 2. Rarity changed from Rare to Uncommon. 
[*]Downy Dandelion: Removal of skill "APPEARANCE: Charges 1 cell. DEATH: Inflicts 1 damage on adjacent cells." Attack increased from 1 to 2.[/list]
 

[b]Infinites[/b]
 
[list][*]Atcham *: HP increased from 2 to 3.
[*]Atcham **: HP increased from 3 to 4.
[*]Atcham ***: HP increased from 4 to 5.
[*]Bakara **: Skill changed: "APPEARANCE: Retrieve the last 2 spells that went to your discard pile." becomes: "APPEARANCE: Retrieve the last spell that went to each player's discard pile."
[*]Bakara ***: Skill changed: "APPEARANCE: Retrieve the last spell that went to your discard pile and the last one that went to your opponent's." becomes: "APPEARANCE: Retrieve the last 2 spells that went to your discard pile."
[*]Count Harebourg *: Skill changed: "As long as it is in play, double the AP obtained by your prisms." becomes: "APPEARANCE: Collect all the AP prisms in play."
[*]Count Harebourg **: Skill changed: "APPEARANCE: Collect all the AP prisms in play". becomes: "As long as he is in play, allied Minions pick up twice as many prisms." Attack increased from 2 to 4. Cost increased from 4 AP to 5 AP.
[*]Count Harebourg ***: Attack increased from 2 to 4.
[*]Kabrok *: Attack increased from 3 to 4. HP increased from 2 to 4.
[*]Kabrok **: Skill changed: "APPEARANCE: Fills your and your opponent's hand with Crobaks." becomes: "APPEARANCE: Fills both players' hands with Crobaks. As long as he is in play, enemy Crobaks cost 1 AP more." Attack increased from 3 to 4.
[*]Black Crow ***: Skill changed: "APPEARANCE: Transforms your Minions into Crobaks, then gains +1 AT and +1 AR per allied Crobak in play." becomes: "APPEARANCE: Summons a Crobak on each cell on its row. Gains +1 AT and +1 AR per allied Crobak that comes into play." Cost increased from 7 AP to 8 AP.
[*]Kerub **: Cost reduced from 4 AP to 3 AP.
[*]Kerub ***: Cost reduced from 6 AP to 4 AP. HP reduced from 5 to 4.[/list]
 

[b]Neutral Krosmics[/b]
 
[list][*]Miranda: Attack increased from 2 to 3. HP increased from 2 to 3.
[*]Ferflee: Skill changed: "APPEARANCE: Charges to the opponent's Dofus then dies at the end of the turn." becomes: "APPEARANCE: Charges to the opponent's Dofus, then dies."
[*]Chafer King: Skill changed: "Whenever an allied Minion dies, it is brought back to life as a Decrepit Chafer. DEATH: Summons a Decrepit Chafer." becomes: "PILE OF BONES. APPEARANCE: Transforms all allied Piles of Bones into Decrepit Chafers." Attack increased from 5 to 7. HP increased from 5 to 7.
[*]Sire Flexington: Skill changed: "Your Dofus return any damage they suffer to the first enemy Minion on their row." becomes: "Whenever one of your Dofus suffers damage, the enemy Dofus on its row suffers an equal amount of damage.[/list]
 

[b]Ecaflip[/b]
 
[list][*]Craps: Effect changed: "Inflicts 8 damage or 4 damage shared among the enemy Dofus." becomes: "Inflicts 6 damage or 3 damage shared among the enemy Dofus."[/list]
 

[b]Iop[/b]
 
[list][*]Call to Brawl: Effect changed: "Draw 4 cards. Keep the Minions and discard any others." becomes: "Puts the first 3 Iops from your deck in your hand." Cost reduced from 7 AP to 6 AP.
[*]Archilles: Cost reduced from 5 AP to 4 AP.
[*]Eratz the Protester: HP increased from 2 to 3.
[*]Felida: Skill changed: "FINAL BLOW: Adds a Jump spell to your hand." becomes: "Your Minions cost 1 AP less, and your spells cost 1 AP more." Attack reduced from 6 to 5. HP reduced from 6 to 5. Cost reduced from 8 AP to 6 AP.
[*]Gzenah: Skill changed: "APPEARANCE: Gains +1 AT and +1 AR per allied Iop on the board." becomes: "Gains +1 AT and +1 AR whenever an allied Iop enters into play.".
[*]First Strike: Cost reduced from 4 AP to 3 AP.
[*]Katsu Mi: Attack increased from 4 to 5.
[*]Devastate: Effect changed: "Confers +2 AT and first strike on a Minion" becomes: "Confers +2 AT and first strike on an allied Iop." Cost reduced from 6 AP to 5 AP.
[*]Sono Sino: Skill changed: "START OF TURN: Your other Minions charge 1 cell." becomes: "APPEARANCE: Gains +1 AR if you have another Iop in play." Attack increased from 3 to 4. HP increased from 3 to 4.[/list]
 

[b]Xelor[/b]
 
[list][*]Corum: Attack increased from 5 to 6. HP increased from 3 to 4.
[*]Exactitude: Adds 5 AP to your reserve and 3 AP to your opponent's reserve. Cost reduced from 3 AP to 2 AP.
[*]Clock: Cost reduced from 2 AP to 0 AP.
[*]Many of Brakmar: Skill changed: "APPEARANCE: Destroys 2 AP from your opponent's reserve." becomes: "APPEARANCE: Puts the next Xelor card from your deck costing 4 AP in your hand.". Attack increased from 1 to 2. Cost increased from 2 AP to 3 AP.
[*]Miss Night: Cost reduced from 6 AP to 4 AP.
[*]Missiz Freezz: Skill changed: "DEATH: Destroys 2 AP from your reserve and returns to your hand." becomes "DEATH: Spends 1 AP from your reserve and returns to your hand."
[*]Patek Tag: Cost reduced from 2 AP to 1 AP.
[*]Quartz: Cost reduced from 4 AP to 3 AP. HP increased from 2 to 3.
[*]Radoris Montrouge: Skill changed: "APPEARANCE: Spends AP from your reserve to gain an equal amount of AT and AR." becomes: " Spends 1 AP from your reserve to be summoned. APPEARANCE: Spends your AP. Gains +1 AT and+1 AR per AP spent." Cost reduced from 1 AP to 0 AP.
[*]Xelor's Sandglass: Effect changed: "Destroys 1 AP from your opponent's reserve and adds 1 AP to your own." becomes: "Spends all AP in your reserve to gain twice as much for this turn.". Cost increased from 1 AP to 3 AP.
[*]Meticulous Synchronizer: Skill changed: "APPEARANCE: Adds 1 AP to your reserve per allied Minion in play." becomes: "APPEARANCE: Spends 1 AP from your reserve and gives +1 AT and +1 AR to your other Xelors.". Attack increased from 3 to 5. HP increased from 2 to 5. Cost increased from 5 AP to 6 AP.
[*]Xelorium: Cost reduced from 4 AP to 0 AP.[/list]
 

[b]Sacrier[/b]
 
[list][*]Tex Alyckn: Skill changed: "INJURED: + 2 AT and + 1 MP." becomes: "INJURED: + 2 AT."
Punishment: Cost increased from 7 AP to 8 AP.[/list]
 

[b][u]MISCELLANEOUS[/u][/b]
 
[list][*]"As Old As The World" quest: The text has been changed to "Collect 16 Enutrofs" for this quest.
[*]"Faithful Companions" quest: The text has been changed to "Collect 14 Drhellers" for this quest.
[*]Xelor Basic Deck: Many of Brakmar is no longer part of this deck. He is replaced by Patek Tag.
[*]Fixed a display bug that occurred when dragging a card off-screen during deck creation.
[*]Fixed a bug concerning the loading of  the player's data.[/list]
